title: SS28 Men's Trim Stories
summary: Trims that carry each SS28 menswear theme.
research_period: SS28 previews published November 2025 to November 2026; SS27 runway record

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. SS28 fabric fairs open with Première Vision Paris on 26-28 January 2027, and the shows run from June to October 2027. This report projects from the first SS28 forecaster and fair previews, the SS27 runways and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it after the fairs and again after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: - Milano Unica's SS28 theme "Metamorphosis" rests on Lightness, Enrichment ("the rediscovery of handcrafted techniques") and Adaptability, with LIGHTWEAR, HANDWEAR and TECHWEAR themes<sup>[1]</sup>
